name: Phu Cam Cathedral
kicker: The cathedral on Phuoc Qua hill
summary: The cathedral of the Archdiocese of Hue on Phước Quả hill, a modern church by the architect Ngô Viết Thụ, with a nave of tall windows and parabolic arches. Walk the grounds, or sit in for Sunday mass. Go for the city’s Catholic landmark, a contrast to the pagodas and the court.
getThere: Phước Quả hill: 01 Đoàn Hữu Trưng or 06 Nguyễn Trường Tộ (both on the city page).
heroCaption: The nave and parabolic arches at Phu Cam

notice.title: Two street addresses
notice.body: The city page gives both 01 Đoàn Hữu Trưng, Phước Vĩnh ward, and 06 Nguyễn Trường Tộ. The grounds and the mass times also come from that page only.

body: Phủ Cam is the cathedral of the Archdiocese of Hue, on Phước Quả hill. The design is by Ngô Viết Thụ, and the grounds are 10,804 square metres.
The grounds are open around the clock for a look outside. Weekday mass runs between 05:00 and 18:00, and Sunday mass is at 05:30, 08:00, 15:00, and 18:30.
From the centre, take Đống Đa, turn right onto Hai Bà Trưng, continue to Phan Đình Phùng, turn left onto Nguyễn Trường Tộ, and go on to the Hàm Nghi–Đoàn Hữu Trưng junction.

figures.caption: The window wall inside the cathedral
figures.alt: Tall windows along the wall of the nave at Phu Cam Cathedral

gettingThere: From the south bank: Đống Đa, right on Hai Bà Trưng, on to Phan Đình Phùng, left on Nguyễn Trường Tộ, then Hàm Nghi to Đoàn Hữu Trưng.

legs.heading: From the south bank
legs.body: Đống Đa, Hai Bà Trưng, Phan Đình Phùng, Nguyễn Trường Tộ.

hours: Grounds 24 hours. Weekday mass 05:00–18:00. Sunday mass 05:30, 08:00, 15:00, 18:30 (English city page, one source). Confirm on arrival.
closed: No weekly closing day on the city page.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. The city page prints no fee.
